subject: Social Media
title: Collaborative Filtering
description: A quick, practical guide to Collaborative Filtering.

hook.text: Amazon noticed in 1998: people who bought diapers also bought beer. A pattern emerged.

buildup.text: Collaborative filtering finds users like you and recommends what they liked. No analysis needed.

discovery.text: Netflix built its recommendation engine this way. It matched viewers by rating patterns alone.

twist.text: New users break the system. With no history, there's nothing to match. The cold-start problem.

climax.text: Social media fixed it by watching everything—likes, pauses, scroll speed. Your behavior is the data.

punchline.text: You never rated anything. Your clicks did.

quiz.question: What problem does collaborative filtering face with new users?
